## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with a lively face, rosy cheeks, and black eyes. She has a full head of jet-black, glossy hair styled in dark curls.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Personality

Diana Barry is a practical, ladylike, and sympathetic companion who is considered a comfortable, good, kind, and sweet friend. She possesses a notable taste in dressing, leading others to frequently seek her advice on the subject. Additionally, she is skilled at making splendid lettuce salad.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## History

Diana Barry was named by a schoolmaster who was boarding at her home when she was born. In her youth, she and her friend [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) once imagined ghosts into the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood). Diana met [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), where the two girls swore a solemn oath of eternal friendship. Their bond was briefly interrupted when Diana's mother forbade them from playing together, but Diana secretly sent [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a note at school. After Diana's sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) contracted severe croup while their parents were away, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) saved the child's life, prompting Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and allow the girls to be best friends again. Later, Diana helped [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recover after a fall at a party and eventually brought her the news that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) had tied for first place on the Island on the Queen's entrance examinations. As young adults, Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) active joined the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), where they canvassed their assigned roads and confronted local residents over civic matters. On one outing to search for a replacement platter, Diana stood by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) through a rainstorm after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) crashed through a duckhouse roof, remaining with her until they were freed and invited to tea. Diana later introduced [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to Hester Gray's forgotten garden, brought chicken to help [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) save a dinner party for guest visitors, and got lost with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a trip that led them to meet Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Upon learning that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) would leave [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Diana grieved losing her friend's constant presence, though the two reaffirmed their deep bond. Shortly before helping prepare Miss Lavendar's wedding, Diana fell in love with [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) and visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), +56 more_

## Quotes

> “Why, I guess so,” she said frankly. “I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> “Yes,” said Diana, tossing her head, “but I’m sure he doesn’t like Julia Bell so very much. I’ve heard him say he studied the multiplication table by her freckles.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> “Those Pye girls are cheats all round,” said Diana indignantly, as they climbed the fence of the main road. “Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

> "Why, he makes fun of all the girls. He laughs at mine because it’s so black. He’s called me a crow a dozen times; and I never heard him apologize for anything before, either."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I do think you’re mean. What shall I do? Mr. Phillips will make me sit with that horrid Gertie Pye—I know he will because she is sitting alone. Do come back, Anne."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are close friends, confidantes, and playmates who created [Idlewild](../codex/places.md#idlewild) together. Their bond was forged instantly when they swore a solemn oath of friendship, though it faced a temporary separation when Diana's mother forbade them from playing together. The friendship was restored after they nursed Diana's sick sister through the night, saving her life.
